# VIT Bhopal FFCS Timetable Maker

> A free web app that helps VIT Bhopal University students plan their semester timetable under the Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS). Students add courses, pick a faculty and slot for each, and see a weekly timetable that blocks slot clashes. It is an independent student project by Mehul K. Patel, not an official VIT Bhopal service, and it does not register courses on VTOP.

## What it does

- Import course and faculty data from the VTOP mock registration page (save the faculty list page as "Webpage, HTML Only" and upload it), from a CSV file, from data an AI chatbot extracts from a VTOP screenshot, or by manual entry.
- Automatic slot clash detection when choosing a faculty and slot.
- Auto-generate clash-free timetables from selected courses, with preferences for morning, afternoon or middle slots, avoiding 8:30 AM or 7:30 PM classes, and ranking preferred faculty.
- Save multiple timetable drafts, preview them and apply one with a click.
- Export the timetable as a PDF.
- Weekly grid covers Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM to 7:30 PM.

## Accounts and data

- Free to use. No payment or paid tier.
- Works without an account (guest mode). Guest data is deleted after 7 days.
- Login is with a Google account on the vitbhopal.ac.in domain only. Logged-in timetables are kept across devices.
- On first login, if the account has no timetable yet, the guest's courses and saved timetables move to the account.

## Pages

- [Timetable maker (home)]({{ site_url }}/): build and view your timetable, import courses, FAQ
- [Auto-generate timetable]({{ site_url }}/api/generate/page): generate clash-free timetables from preferences
